name: convo_v2_chat_turn
description: v2: one chat turn behind the web page. Loads the previous turn, asks the LLM, saves the trimmed history.

inputTemplate.systemPrompt: You are a wealth advisor assistant. Be concise.

tasks.name: has_prev
tasks.description: Is there a previous turn to load?

load.name: load_prev
load.description: Get Workflow: fetch the previous turn (its output holds the history). Optional: a bad id just means a fresh start.

tasks.name: build_messages
tasks.description: Keep the old history only if the previous turn completed in this same session, then build the LLM messages.

inputParameters.queryExpression: (.prev.response.body? // .prev.workflow? // .prev) as $p | ((($p | type) == "object") and ($p | .status) == "COMPLETED" and ($p | .input.sessionId) == .sessionId) as $ok | (if $ok then (($p | .output.history) // []) else [] end) as $h | {restored: $ok, history: $h, messages: ([{role: "system", message: .systemPrompt}] + $h + [{role: "user", message: .message}])}

tasks.name: chat
tasks.description: Ask the LLM for the next reply.

tasks.name: save_history
tasks.description: Append this exchange and keep the last 20 messages (always starting with the user).

inputParameters.queryExpression: (.reply | if type == "string" then . else tojson end) as $r | ((.history // []) + [{role: "user", message: .message}, {role: "assistant", message: $r}]) as $all | {history: ($all | .[-20:])}
